'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jake Nelson DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''senate. its whats for breakfast.'''. No username. Typed. Neither LIGHT nor DARK box is checked; the list is Dark. L4 sheet tatooine: mauls landing site → Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (the Tatooine site whose text is Maul deploys free here). L5 sheet naboo:3/2 → Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core. Dark printing is Dark Force ×3 and Light Force ×2, the only Naboo site with that count. L28 typed orn free ta, same card as L27. L36 written short range fighters combo → Short Range Fighters & Watch Your Back!. L52 sfs laser cannon → SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons. Shields are handwritten and the boxes are empty. Shield 2 Ultimatum is the Light shield (no Dark card of that name). Shield 5 is a struck line replaced by Aim High.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
